description: This file is a C source code for a pin multiplexing driver for the ARM MPS2 AN385 Board in the Zephyr RTOS. It configures GPIO controllers and maps board pins to GPIO functions.

methods.name: arm_mps2_pinmux_defaults
methods.description: Sets default pin multiplexing configurations for the GPIO controllers on the board.

methods.name: arm_mps2_pinmux_init
methods.description: Initializes the pinmux settings during system startup.
